First, we find $v(t)$ by integrating the acceleration with respect to time:

$$
\begin{aligned}v(t) & =\int a(t)\text{d}t \\  & =\int (12{t}^{3}+20t)\text{d}t \\  & =3{t}^{4}+10{t}^{2}+C\end{aligned}
$$

To determine $C$, we use the fact that $v(1)=25.$ Substituting this into the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}25 & =3({1}^{4})+10({1}^{2})+C \\ 25 & =13+C \\ C & =12.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the velocity of the particle at time $t$ is $v(t)=3{t}^{4}+10{t}^{2}+12.$
